common.tagline: Hot scrubland world of pacifist farmers and Imperial agro-corp leases.
common.government: Imperial governor over Saleucamian farmsteader councils
hyperlanes: Quelii sector trunk off the Triellus Trade Route
common.famousFor: Clone Wars veterans who settled here as homesteaders. Quiet farmland. Imperial agribusiness annexations.
common.cantinaReputation: Arid world dotted with bulbous caldera lakes. Clone deserter Cut Lawquane's farm is here — or was. In 15 BBY, Saleucami is a quiet backwater where settlers scratch out a living. Small settlements offer basic supplies and fuel. The Empire barely bothers with this place, making it a decent spot to lay low.
